description: Search Canada Revenue Agency registered charities (T3010 open data): business number, legal name, designation, category, city and province. Filter by filing year, province, city, designation, category code or keyword. Use it to verify a charity's registration, build non-profit prospect lists or research the charity sector. No directors or contact details. Runs the Apify Actor loudtzu/cra-charities on your own Apify account (pay per event: $0.003 per charity, billed by Apify; Apify platform usage may apply). Store page: https://apify.com/loudtzu/cra-charities

categoryCode.description: Category code. CRA category code, e.g. 0140 (see CRA codes list).

keyword.description: Name contains. Matches legal or account name.

maxItems.description: Max results. Stop after this many rows.

runOptions.description: Optional run limits (not passed to the Actor). maxTotalChargeUsd caps what this single call can cost you on Apify.

maxTotalChargeUsd.description: Hard cap in USD for this run's Actor charges. Defaults to the server's MAX_CHARGE_USD (1.00 unless set).

timeoutSecs.description: Run timeout in seconds (Apify's synchronous limit is 300).

year.description: Data year. T3010 open-data release year.

name: canada_registered_charities
title: Canadian registered charities (CRA open data)
